foreground.scope: Distinct request_id with request_started; user retries count separately

token_budget.correlation_caveat: 2-second temporal correlation without request_id; reported token sum is not billed tokens

database_readonly_snapshot.caveat: Point-in-time database sample, not restricted to rolling log interval

method.logs: Only .zhaoxi/logs/zhaoxi.log*; exclude test artifacts and diagnostic database copies
method.window: Inclusive boundaries; local header timestamps interpreted as Asia/Shanghai
method.request_dedup: request_id; runtime/WEB terminal outcome, not metric result_status defaults
method.beat_dedup: Beat id; last state; silent or gated is not failure
method.metadata_parser: ast.literal_eval for dict repr; json.loads for Beat
method.privacy: No prompts, reply bodies, images, tokens or private conversation content exported
method.side_effects: No model calls, program restart, settings change or production database writes
method.scope_limit: Historical mixed code/config states; no build revision on each log line; semantic bugs may leave no failure log
